component.name: YorkFolio Desktop
component.summary: Holder-style portfolio tracker for B3 investors

description.p: Import the Excel statements from the B3 investor portal and see your positions with average price, net worth and returns over time against CDI and Ibovespa, and your proventos.

It also suggests aportes towards your target allocation and prepares your IR: the monthly DARF and the annual Bens e Direitos. Everything is stored locally in a SQLite file; the interface is in Brazilian Portuguese.
A C++ core computes positions, taxes and the aporte plan; the interface is written in Python with Qt.
